notes: scan050.N1: The page states a special property (16) of the semi-simplicial operation when alpha(0)=0, explains the restriction over each flag component, gives the fibre expression (17), then says general operations (13) and the maps to X in (18) are local immersions. The leaf contains no separate drawing; all visible arrows, two left braces, and the underbrace are mathematical layout.

scan050.N2: Targeted conditional check of the intended component calculation: using the component description written on this page and the stated action alpha-star on flags, a preimage flag i_* of i'_*, under alpha(0)=0, has i_0=i'_0. Each summand over such a flag therefore has the same base X_{i'_0}. Collecting them gives X_{i'_0} times the set of preimage flags, equivalently X_{i'_*} times that set after the written singleton-label identification. This checks the local intended product decomposition. It is conditional on the component model and map description stated in the paragraph, not a reconstruction of their construction on absent pages.

scan050.N3: Formula (17) is transcribed literally with i^1_* in the binding position but i_* in the condition, and with a raised terminal star i'{}^*. Both positions have decisive ink. They appear to be authorial indexing/placement slips relative to the surrounding prose. The intended calculation in N2 does not prove that literal mismatched expression; no silent repair is made.

scan050.N4: In the later sans condition clause the alpha argument has an open omega-like shape. The final output is a closed 0. The earlier alpha(0)=0 condition strongly identifies the likely intention, while the local form remains doubtful. The proposed omega|0 is counted as a tentative preferred-reading difference from both C and H, not as a settled new notation.

scan050.N5: The outer brace of (16) ends at the tuple-mapping row. The final est un morphisme de rev. étale lies below it. The inner brace groups the two particular-example rows. The opening parenthesis before en particulier has no visible closer, and the final predicate has no stop. These incomplete punctuation and grouping details are preserved.

scan050.N6: The claims that the displayed maps are étale coverings in the special case and local immersions in the general case were carried as background. No proof of the underlying geometric construction, and no verification of the absent numbered item (13), was attempted from other pages.

scan050.N7: There is no dark authorial page numeral at the head of this sheet. The pale bottom-left 49 belongs to another hand and is recorded as a margin element. H omits it; changing C's mspage macro to margin does not change the numeral and is not counted against C.

scan050.N8: Exact short forms are retained: two rev. occurrences in (16), undotted rev in the explanatory paragraph, undotted ens in l'ens, and imm. in prose and (18). Quand aux remains the written wording. H's applications, immer., added commas, extra parenthesis and final stops are not supported by the ink.

scan050.N9: All four cancellation sites and both raised insertions were checked for exact scope and attachment. The component-identity leader is not a parenthesis; the i_* leader attaches after drapeaux. Underlines under the two imm. phrases and the underbrace below X_i-prime-star are not cancellations.

scan050.N10: Layout page and both supplied native halves were viewed once, every line and symbol compared with both witnesses, and all 19 saved crops inspected. r06 was extended once while still open to include clipped upper tips of the raised formula. The audit boxes group the sloping adjacent lines into complete reading blocks; b03 includes the full (17), following paragraph, and (18), avoiding clipped line edges. Every formula number, inline reference, numeric index/exponent, foliation, insertion, cancellation and differing word is included. TeX was not compiled.

scan050.N11. Main-reader targeted check using the component description read on scans 048–049: a flag i_0<=...<=i_r contributes a copy of X_{i_0}, an open-and-closed summand of X_{Delta_r}. Precomposition by alpha maps it to the summand with first index i_{alpha(0)}, by the closed inclusion X_{i_0}->X_{i_{alpha(0)}}. Thus each summand map is a closed embedding into an open-and-closed target component, proving the claimed local-immersion property. For alpha(0)=0 the base inclusion is the identity; over each target component the map is the product projection with the discrete set of preimage flags, hence the stated constant étale covering there. Similarly each summand of X_{Delta_r}->X is a closed inclusion and gives a local immersion. This checks the intended convention under the earlier closed-subspace hypotheses, while leaving the literal slips and local omega/0 doubt untouched.

scan050.N12. Blind adjudication adds doubt to the looped inserted i_*/d_* label. It also changes the preferred literal reading of the final label to imm. focale, with locale retained as alternative: its initial has an f-like descender and crossing unlike the ordinary l of locales in the same paragraph. Locale is the mathematically intended property checked in N11; that expectation does not erase the f-like ink. The full formula still has the literal i^1_* binding and raised terminal star, Quand still ends in d, and the later alpha argument retains omega/0. The small angular i dots are treated consistently as this hand's dot shapes, not a new hat notation.

second_changes.evidence: The whole formula and paragraph, plus r12/r18, were inspected. The bound-variable upper stroke has a flag and foot separate from the i dot, supporting literal 1; the final star is clearly high beside the prime. Keep both visible index slips. The last letter of Quand has a short closed body and ascender, not an independent t crossbar. The local alpha argument remains open with two bowls, favoring omega over the neighboring closed zero while preserving zero as alternative. Cancelled donc ends in a low c return; the long oblique is the strike, not t. In (18), however, the initial of the final word has an upper loop, a long descender below the underline and a separate horizontal crossing, markedly f-like beside the ordinary l of locales above. Prefer focale with locale explicit as alternative; mathematical expectation does not decide that glyph.
